sourceProvenance.scope: Current documented service import and exported-run lifecycle; page includes desktop TypeScript preview warning.
Legacy @adsk/fas TaskParameters/adsk.parameters/adsk.result and parameter/save flow; not proof of current service declarations.

verification.procedure: Verify the exact new item/version in its approved folder, request identity, reopened parameter values, template timeline/body checks and independent dimensional/geometry checks. Hash any exported validation artifacts. Provider compute or save completion alone is insufficient; never authorize release.

publicClientActivation.instruction: Do not use generic signed TaskScript authority as a managed boundary. A qualified constrained publisher activity and its signature are separately required for public_pkce.

limitations: This object is deliberately not a recipesFile registry array and is rejected as active configuration.
REVIEW_BINDINGS in main.ts is null; the script fails before opening a document until qualified bindings are installed.
Autodesk.Fusion+Latest rolls; no immutable engine or unavoidable alias-repointing race elimination is promised.
The cost model and input/output byte limits are admission controls, not a hard billing or cloud save size ceiling.
The new destination item/version does not exist before save; it is recorded only after readback and never guessed.
The recipe creates an unreleased candidate copy, never overwrites the source, advances PLM lifecycle or generates NC.
The service module, TaskParameters/result channel and lifecycle must be verified against the actual supplied service declarations and a disposable live canary before activation.
